import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorMultiplication
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4LocalTaylorDerivation
import Mathlib.RingTheory.PowerSeries.Derivative

/-!
# Taylor series of local functions

The coefficients in a specified local parameter assemble into an algebra
homomorphism to formal power series. Differentiation in that parameter agrees
with formal differentiation. These comparisons transfer integral coefficient
identities to local residue calculations in Hartshorne III.7.14.1.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

open IsLocalRing

noncomputable section

variable {k R : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
  [IsLocalRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (c0 : R →ₗ[k] k)
  (hc0 : ∀ a : R, residue R (algebraMap k R (c0 a)) = residue R a)
  (t : R) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (ht : maximalIdeal R = Ideal.span {t})

/-- The Taylor expansion homomorphism for a specified local parameter. -/
def localTaylorSeries : R →ₐ[k] PowerSeries k where
  toFun a := PowerSeries.mk fun n => localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n a
  map_zero' := by ext n; simp
  map_one' := by ext n; simp
  map_add' a b := by ext n; simp
  map_mul' a b := by
    ext n
    simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, PowerSeries.coeff_mul,
      localTaylorCoefficient_mul]
    rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ_mk]
  commutes' c := by
    ext n
    simp only [PowerSeries.coeff_mk, localTaylorCoefficient_algebraMap,
      PowerSeries.algebraMap_eq, PowerSeries.coeff_C]

@[simp]
theorem coeff_localTaylorSeries (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (localTaylorSeries c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a) =
      localTaylorCoefficient c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n a :=
  by simp [localTaylorSeries]

/-- The specified local parameter expands to the formal variable. -/
@[simp]
theorem localTaylorSeries_parameter :
    localTaylorSeries c0 hc0 t ht0 ht t = PowerSeries.X := by
  ext n
  cases n with
  | zero =>
    simpa using localConstantTerm_parameter_mul c0 hc0 t ht 1
  | succ n =>
    simpa [PowerSeries.coeff_X] using
      localTaylorCoefficient_succ_parameter_mul c0 hc0 t ht0 ht n 1

/-- A derivation sending the parameter to one commutes with Taylor expansion. -/
theorem localTaylorSeries_derivation (d : Derivation k R R) (hdt : d t = 1) (a : R) :
    localTaylorSeries c0 hc0 t ht0 ht (d a) =
      PowerSeries.derivative k (localTaylorSeries c0 hc0 t ht0 ht a) := by
  ext n
  rw [coeff_localTaylorSeries, PowerSeries.coeff_derivative, coeff_localTaylorSeries,
    localTaylorCoefficient_derivation c0 hc0 t ht0 ht d hdt]
  exact mul_comm _ _

end
end Hartshorne
